verdict.rationale: Gemini documents its own privacy controls: users can turn off Keep Activity, delete their Gemini Apps activity at any time, and audio, Live video and screenshare use for model training is opt-in, with chats not used to improve models under the documented conditions. These controls cover activity retention and training use, but the evidence never describes an opt-out for app telemetry, diagnostics or usage analytics as such. missing for 10: explicit telemetry/diagnostics/usage-analytics opt-out, documentation of what tracking remains when Keep Activity is off, independent or hands-on corroboration
